topic.label: Systems Engineering and Reliability
topic.desc: Systems Engineering and Reliability: Systems Modeling and Architecture, Systems Thinking and Feedback, Boundaries and Interfaces and Reliability and Failure Modes.

concepts.label: Systems Modeling and Architecture
concepts.desc: Modeling a system's structure and behavior: components, data flow, decomposition and architecture views.

concepts.label: Systems Thinking and Feedback
concepts.desc: Stocks and flows, feedback loops, delays, leverage points and emergent behavior of systems.

concepts.label: Boundaries and Interfaces
concepts.desc: Where a system ends, what crosses its boundary, and the interfaces and contracts between components.

concepts.label: Reliability and Failure Modes
concepts.desc: How systems fail: failure modes, redundancy, single points of failure, cascading failure and resilience.

skills.label: Architecture View Builder
skills.desc: Builds architecture views of a system (context, containers, components) from a description.

skills.label: System Decomposer
skills.desc: Decomposes a system into subsystems and components with their responsibilities and data flow.

skills.label: Feedback Loop Mapper
skills.desc: Maps the feedback loops in a system and labels each reinforcing or balancing, with its delays.

skills.label: Leverage Point Finder
skills.desc: Names where a small change to a system would have large effect, with reasoning.

skills.label: Boundary Definer
skills.desc: Defines what is inside and outside a system and what crosses the boundary.

skills.label: Interface Contract Writer
skills.desc: Writes the contract for an interface between components: inputs, outputs, errors and guarantees.

skills.label: Failure Mode Analyzer
skills.desc: Lists a system's failure modes, their effects and detection, ranked by severity.

skills.label: Single Point of Failure Finder
skills.desc: Finds single points of failure in a system design and suggests redundancy.
